rustTests.provenance: TASK-1417; Rust unchanged in TASK-1418; also run by GitHub Windows CI

results.name: Main UI mounts
Settings and image editor renderers are absent until requested
No Windows caption; DPI bounds match canvas
Bootstrap uses real audio device
Chosen audio endpoint changes monitoring without rerouting sound
Capture visibility setting changes native display protection
Chosen microphone remains readable without recording or mute changes
Native notification and network reads return usable contracts
Settings merge + persist, toggles do not crash
Island scale changes physical size, viewport and clip bounds together
Weather search works offline for Брянск
Media source and playback contracts
Weather opens, switches hours/week and units, and rejects legacy data
Live Yandex connector reaches the rendered pill with cover and advancing time
Plain island and visible pause collapse after 2500 ms despite repeated metadata
LRCLIB milliseconds highlight, advance, pause and seek the rendered lyrics
Lyrics keep stable geometry across short, wrapped and unbroken lines
Disabled download cards and agent questions suppress their UI events
Optional hover opens after its delay; click remains the default
Opening the releases page does not leave a fictitious download running
WASAPI follows the active player output and animates the liquid spectrum
Repeated hover keeps the folded pill visible and native styles unchanged
Click expands, Escape collapses
Native desktop pixels outside collapsed and expanded island have no glass tint
Notes/chat/timer/launcher groups round-trip
Launcher link and shelf persist
Agents state and config ownership are read without changing fixtures
Web AI read contract and invalid service rejection
Claude single and multiple choices reach the real answer file
Store inventory and icons are native; launcher accepts an installed AUMID
PPTX attachments preserve presentation order and Unicode text
Attachments return document/image contracts and missing-file errors
AI models, UTF-8 streaming, attachment resolution and HTTP error events
OBS v5 handshake authenticates, reads state and rejects bad password
Native screen capture produces real PNG and dimensions
Windows OCR recognizes actual rendered text from a PNG
MP4 screen recording contains video and WASAPI system audio
Image editor loads and saves its isolated fixture without clipboard writes
Settings UI renders after repeated harmless toggles
Notes button exports Markdown to Obsidian without overwriting files
Steam progress and completion use actual manifest changes
Virtual desktop telemetry reaches the real frontend store
Restart restores settings, notes, chat, timer, launcher and shelf
No unhandled frontend exceptions
Explicit quit exits the application

notes: All native writes use isolated temporary profiles. Personal screenshots, paths and media are excluded.
The first new native scenario incorrectly used automatic media selection; it was corrected to select a paused isolated fixture. The final full run passed.
No new CPU or memory reduction is claimed; TASK-1417 performance report remains the prior comparison.
Characters are procedural SVG. Metadata and policies migrated; drawing implementations still in compat JS.
GitHub publication uses a private feature branch and PR. Owner performs merge to main.
